replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
To add onto the current comments of this thread, once you have created a map, make a thread for the map under the "Map Releases" section on the forums. Make sure you have it labeled with one of the following tags:

→ [DTM]
→ [TDM]
→ [Nexus]
→ [CTH]
→ [Walls]
→ [Avicade] (For this one also include which Avicade gamemode it is such as Red Alert, CaveIn, Minotaur etc.)

Your thread must include a YAML, a download to the map, and pictures of your map. Also make sure that your map is original and is created in a void world.
If you wish for further help, you may contact me on my skype (thehoopsman)
